column3: General or suggested admission is free (or always free for core galleries).
Free or paid timed reservations needed for entry.
Reduced price for seniors (Usually 65+ with ID).
Reduced price for students (with valid ID).
Free admission for kids (usually under 12-16; age varies).
Early access, free entry, discounts, or exclusive events for memebers.
On-site or nearby parking available but costs money (often with time of day discounts).
Free parking (sometimes for specific groups like military/veterans or after certain hours).
Wheelchair access, care partner free entry, assistive services, etc.
Free or low-cost audio guides, app tours, or daily docent-led tours.
On-site restaurants, cafes, or food options.
Museum stores for souvenirs, books, art related items.
Interative or educational programs geared toward families/children.
Strong emphasis on subway/bus access; limited parking encouraged.
Some rotating exhibits require additional tickets beyond general admission.
Free or discounted days/pricing specifically for local residents.
Free WiFi, mobile apps, or interactive digital experiences.
Outdoor sculpture gardens, architecture, or scenic areas.
